whyThisMatters:
It's an academy for data engineering and AI, for people who already work as engineers. They want interview practice that feels like a big-tech loop, not a learn-to-code site for beginners. Courses, plus drills. SQL on a timer, data modeling, behavioral questions. You hit submit and it gets graded.

Some drills are free. Some you pay for. There are apps on the App Store and Google Play, and a Trustpilot page, so it's not only a browser tab and a Discord. Student comments talk about video lessons, help setting up a coding environment, and support from the instructor's staff. The instructor they name is Zach. One student describes him as someone who has built systems, not only taught them.

You sign up, you do the courses, you practice interviews, you stay around while you're paying. A membership, not a bootcamp that ends on a Friday. That's why a course business can sit next to software in these notes. You're paying for access that stays open, not for a single workshop.

The learner count on their site is their own marketing number. The page is still the best place to see the syllabus. Data engineering, AI, and interview practice for people who already have a job.
